unchanged_contract: No source/v1 overwrite or baseline adoption
0.81-0.99 V project supply range; this comparison stays FF, 0.99 V, -40 C
Identical external sampling window and closing edge; no input smoothing, time alignment or waveform fitting
Approved 1 mV amplitude, 5 ps peak/edge, 1 mV initial and 1 nA KCL screens unchanged
Parent reviews exact new recipe, load boundary and budget before managed dispatch; one heavy job at a time

steps.purpose: Locate whether the shift begins at the loaded SN net or downstream LIVE generator
steps.scope: Existing raw histories only, zero through 41.590785651 ns; preserve native rows and initial state; validate exact TRACE instead of assuming requested save resolves

steps.single_variable: Tighten requested reltol by one decade, from 1e-6 to 1e-7
steps.preserve: Same v1 devices, source/PWL bytes, all current probes, maxstep=10ps, supply/temperature, gear2only and Spectre X CX flags
steps.effective_setting_gate: Current actual log is reltol=1e-7 despite request=1e-6. Confirm the new actual log tightens it; an unchanged effective setting is not a valid numerical control
steps.measure: Absolute source/v1/new peak values and times, selected edge counts/order and LIVE/QUIET delays, initial witnesses, KCL, native point gaps, exact LTE and CMI logs
steps.resource_gate: Retain 1 thread, simulation RSS<=1GiB, analysis<=256MiB, output/collection caps; preserve a refused or exceeded budget rather than bypassing it
steps.interpretation: A change quantifies numerical sensitivity. One new run or disappearance of a warning does not prove convergence or explain all load effects

steps.single_variable: Restore the original X010 fanout branch at matched converged numerical settings
steps.physical_minimum: Full unchanged X010 AND cell: 6 MOS plus one original CMID, with its real WRITE_REQ receiving load. Exact additional receiving-stage boundary must be audited before freezing
steps.constraints: WD stays naturally driven. WRITE_REQ is a new native output, never voltage-clamped. Extending through X011 must not short its PHI_W output to the existing PHI_W replay source
steps.prerequisite: Inspect original WRITE_REQ and X010.N/MID native histories, list all new output/load cuts, and retain unchanged original device parameters; no guessed fixed capacitor or floating four-gate stub is an exact replacement

steps.single_variable: Restore the original X014 fanout branch separately after the X010 comparison
steps.physical_minimum: Full unchanged X014 AND cell: 6 MOS plus one original CMID, with its real PHI_U receivers; exact expanded boundary must be audited
steps.boundary_change: Use the source-native UD history only at an omitted upstream input. Move the PHI_U cut outward/remove PHI_U replay when X014 becomes its physical driver; never clamp the new active output. Check resulting PHI_U and upstream/downstream loading against source
steps.prerequisite: Original UD and X014.N/MID histories are explicitly saved but not yet locally exported. Do not invent UD, tie unknown pins to a rail, or assume four added MOS alone reproduce the missing nonlinear gate load

decision_rules: If numerical sensitivity is comparable to the current +1.248169mV or -3.774844ps mismatch, establish numerical convergence before attributing the remainder to fanout
At matched numerical settings, restore each fanout branch separately and compare absolute native waveforms without alignment
Only once peak amplitude and all other fixed reproduction screens pass may a faithful fixture support original-circuit current attribution
No sizing optimization or full-ADC rerun is proposed at this stage
